blocks.body: Dess Abeje, a prominent Ethiopian rapper, songwriter, producer, and music video director, has a rich and diverse portfolio of work. His artistic journey has been marked by continuous evolution, with each collaboration refining his unique identity. Dess’ music is characterized by a distinctive blend of hip-hop and storytelling that resonates deeply with audiences. His projects often explore themes that are both relatable and thought-provoking. this project tells the story of how the new identity project was crafted and then the motif implemented on more items to deliver identity through Motion Graphix, Album art & design Teaser materials for the new album.
